Bringing Salesforce to Copilot as we build Copilot as the OS for work!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Satya Nadella megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Salesforce (@salesforce); megjelent: 2026-11-17T21:07:43+00:00; link: https://x.com/salesforce/status/2122798862641291665; média: videó, 47 másodperc]
Introducing Copilotforce

Salesforce customer context and sales workflows are coming to @MSFTCopilot and @MicrosoftTeams—where more than 400M people already collaborate

Our expanded partnership with @Microsoft spans Copilot, Teams & Fabric:

→ Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot will help sellers prepare for meetings, spot deal risks & take supported Salesforce actions, informed by customer context, emails, meetings & shared documents

→ @SalesCloud in Teams will bring pipeline insights, deal alerts & supported opportunity updates into Teams, with Agentforce Coworker helping sellers delegate work & take action

→ Data 360 + Microsoft Fabric connect through bidirectional zero copy, so teams can access data across both platforms without duplicating source datasets

→ @Informatica expands its Microsoft integrations to help teams find trusted data in Copilot, build governed AI agents in Foundry & trace data lineage in Fabric

@Accenture joins as Customer Zero and design and implementation partner to help shape and validate Copilotforce within its global sales organization, after scaling Microsoft Copilot to 740,000+ people

See what’s new from #MSIgnite: https://sforce.co/4kgw4iZ
